01JAVA · MACHINE LEARNING

B2B Dynamic Pricing
Optimization Engine

From transaction patterns to pricing recommendations. A Java application that predicts demand and compares candidate prices against business constraints.

  • Java 17
  • Random Forest
  • SVR
  • Swing
Inside the project ＋

The approach. Prepare synthetic transaction data, use a chronological train/validation/test split, compare demand models and evaluate possible prices within stock and cost constraints.

The evidence. The public Java edition includes reproducible evaluation, a desktop interface, documentation and 22 automated tests. The included data is synthetic; results do not represent production business gains.
